Bill.BriefDescription: Allowing narrow vehicles to drive side by side in one lane.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to vehicles driven side by side in a single lane;amending RCW 46.61.608; and adding a new section to chapter 46.04 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 46.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: "Ultranarrow vehicle" means a vehicle having a maximum width offortytwo inches from mirror to mirror.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 46.61.608 and 1975 c 62 s 46 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) All motorcycles and ultranarrow vehicles are entitled to fulluse of a lane and no motor vehicle shall be driven in such a manner asto deprive any motorcycle or ultranarrow vehicle of the full use of alane. This subsection shall not apply to motorcycles or ultranarrowvehicles operated two abreast in a single lane, under subsection (4) ofthis section. (2) The operator of a motorcycle or ultranarrow vehicle shall notovertake and pass in the same lane occupied by the vehicle beingovertaken. p. 1 SSB 5986 (3) No person shall operate a motorcycle or ultranarrow vehiclebetween lanes of traffic or between adjacent lines or rows of vehicles. (4) Motorcycles ((shall not)) and ultranarrow vehicles may beoperated ((more than)) up to two abreast in a single lane. (5) Subsections (2) and (3) of this section shall not apply topolice officers in the performance of their official duties.
